label: Accordion
desc: A list of sections that open and close, one click each. Each section owns its own state, so opening one never closes another, and the chevron swaps glyph rather than rotating so it reads correctly with animation off. The whole header row is the hit area, not just the words. Out of the box it renders three sample sections from a Static Data node; connect your own array (Title/Body per item, optional Start Open) to Items and it wins over the samples.

label: App Shell
desc: The frame an app lives inside: a sidebar (app name slot + data-driven nav items with active-route highlighting), a top bar (page title, actions slot, user area placeholder), and a content outlet where your Page Router goes. Nav items are a plain array (Label/Icon/Target) fed from a Static Data node or the Nav Items input; clicking one navigates to its Target and emits Nav Click/Nav Target. Below the Collapse Below breakpoint (default 768px) the sidebar collapses behind a hamburger button.

label: Auth Pages
desc: Complete sign-in flow behind a Page Router: Sign In, Sign Up, Forgot Password and Reset Password pages built on the built-in Log In, Sign Up, Request Password Reset and Reset Password nodes. Labelled email/password inputs, inline error text from each node's Error output, loading state on every submit button, and links between the pages. Fires an "Auth Success" event when a user signs in or signs up.

label: Avatar
desc: A round avatar that shows a photo when it has one and the person's initials when it does not — sized by a single Size input, and ringed so a stack of them stays legible against any background. Avatar Group overlaps them the way you expect and collapses the tail into a "+3" badge once Max is set. Out of the box the group renders five sample people from a Static Data node; connect your own array (Name/Image per item) to Items and it wins over the samples.

label: Card & Card Grid
desc: A styled Card (optional media area on top, title, body text, footer/actions strip, Clicked signal, hover affordance) plus a responsive Card Grid that repeats it over any data array. The grid packs as many 240px-minimum columns as fit and degrades to a single full-width column when narrow. Out of the box it renders six sample cards from a Static Data node; connect your own array (Title/Body/Image/Footer per item) to the Items input and it wins over the samples. The grid forwards each card's click as Card Clicked with Clicked Title and Clicked Item Id.

label: Confirm Dialog
desc: A modal confirmation dialog with the ERG-001 outcome contract: distinct Confirmed and Cancelled signal outputs (never a single ambiguous Closed), Open/Close signal inputs, Title/Message/Confirm Label/Cancel Label string inputs, and a Danger boolean that restyles the confirm button for destructive actions. Clicking the scrim or the cancel button emits Cancelled; only the confirm button emits Confirmed.

label: CRUD Screen
desc: A complete list-edit screen over one cloud collection: Query Records list with full-text search and Prev/Next pagination, a side panel that creates (Create Record) or edits (Update Record, form pre-filled via a Record node) the selected row, and per-row delete with an inline Yes/No confirm (Delete Record). Hand-built loading and empty states. The collection is one input: set Class on the CRUD Screen instance.

label: Date Picker
desc: A date picker input with a pop-up calendar for selecting a date.

label: Email Verification
desc: Cloud functions for email verification and reset password. Configure by provisioning the backend function secrets SENDGRID_API_KEY, EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DOMAIN and EMAIL_VERIFICATION_FROM — see the prefab README.

label: File Upload
desc: A drop zone that walks a file all the way to storage: Open File Picker chooses it, Upload File sends it, Cloud File reads back the URL you can actually link to. It shows what it is the moment you place it — a dashed zone stating the file types and the size limit it will accept — and then owns the whole sequence, with a thumbnail of the file being sent, a real progress bar driven by the transfer's own byte counts, and an error panel that prints the reason rather than going quiet. The size limit is checked in the browser, so the one failure that does not need a server does not wait for one. Publishes Uploaded, the stored Cloud File, its URL and File Name, and a Failed signal with an Error string.

label: Filters
desc: A prefab for creating filter controls that work well with query records.

label: Form
desc: A data-driven form: hand it an array of field descriptors and it builds Text Input, Text Area, Drop Down, Checkbox, Single Choice, Multi Choice, Slider and Date Input controls, collects the values into one object, shows per-field errors and reports a valid Submit. Out of the box it renders five sample fields from a Static Data node; connect your own array to the Controls input and it wins over the samples.

label: Form Fields
desc: Labelled field components for writing one form by hand: Labelled Text Input, Labelled Select, Labelled Checkbox, Labelled Textarea and Labelled Date. Every field has Label, Helper Text, Error (error text shows and the border turns destructive when it is non-empty), Required (asterisk marker) and Disabled inputs, plus Value/Checked and Changed outputs. Consistent 40px control height, Inter typography, design-token colours and a visible focus ring. A Form Fields demo component shows all five stacked.

label: Image Cropper
desc: Image Cropper Module. Mainly intended for cropping profile pictures.

label: List With Icons
desc: A simple list component with icons and labels.

label: Mail Gun
desc: Send emails with Mailgun from a cloud function. Configure by provisioning the backend function secrets MAILGUN_API_KEY and MAILGUN_DOMAIN — see the prefab README.

label: Media Query
desc: Contains a handy component to create responsive interfaces.

label: Multi Select
desc: Multi-select input in three display variants, each a drop-in component: List (checkbox group), Pills (toggleable pill buttons), and Dropdown (a drop-down whose selected items show as removable pills). All three are data-driven — feed an Options array (plus optional Labels and an initial Selection) and read the result from the Selected Items output and the Changed signal.

label: Navigation Menu
desc: Component for creating navigation menus.

label: OAuth2
desc: Cloud functions for oauth2 user authentication.

label: Page Header
desc: Standard page header: an h1 title, an optional subtitle (hidden until set), a data-driven breadcrumb trail and a right-aligned actions slot. Breadcrumbs take an array of {label, target} objects — separators are drawn between crumbs and the last crumb renders inert (foreground colour, no click). Clicking any earlier crumb emits the Crumb Clicked signal with that crumb's target on Crumb Target, ready to wire into navigation. Action buttons are added as children of the placed instance (Component Children slot).

label: Pagination
desc: Full pagination control: page numbers with ellipsis overflow, prev/next buttons, an optional rows-per-page selector and an optional "Showing X–Y of Z" summary. Inputs: Total Items, Items Per Page, Current Page. Outputs: Current Page, Offset (plugs into Query Records' Skip), Items Per Page (plugs into Limit) and a Changed signal. Merges the former Pages And Rows prefab.

label: Panning and Zooming Control
desc: A control that implements a pan and zoom view on large images.

label: Progress Circle
desc: Contains an animating progress visualization in percentage.

label: Rating
desc: An interactive star rating component.

label: Search Bar
desc: A search field that tells you what was typed once the typing stops: textChanged restarts a Timer, the Timer runs the emit, and Enter skips the wait. Query and Changed fire on the debounce, not per keystroke, so you can wire Changed straight at a Query Records without hammering it. The clear button appears only while there is something to clear, and Result Count renders as "1 result" / "1,204 results" beside the field.

label: Send Grid
desc: Send emails with SendGrid from a cloud function. Configure by provisioning the backend function secret SENDGRID_API_KEY — see the prefab README.

label: Settings Page
desc: A sectioned settings form that knows what you have changed. Profile, Notifications and Appearance sections built from labelled text, dropdown and checkbox fields in the same style as Form Fields, plus a save bar that is not there at all until a field actually differs from the value it loaded with — then it names the count ("2 unsaved changes") and offers Save and Discard. Discard puts every field back; Save re-baselines, so the values you just saved become the new "unchanged". Out of the box it loads a realistic sample record from a Static Data node; connect your own object to Settings and it wins. Publishes Values, Is Dirty and Change Count, and fires Saved / Discarded.

label: Shake Detector
desc: A small module to detect a device shake with the accelerometer.

label: States Kit
desc: The four states every list and screen needs: Loading (an inline spinner plus a full-area overlay with a Visible input), Empty (glyph, title, hint and an optional action button with a Clicked signal), Error (message plus a Retry signal output), and Skeleton placeholders (a pulsing text row and a card). Each state is its own component, styled with the project design tokens, with a Demo component showing them together.

label: Stepper
desc: A numbered progress rail with Back/Next and a Finish on the last step. It publishes Current Step and a Completed signal and deliberately does not hold your content: you mount each step's Group against Current Step, so a step is an ordinary part of your page rather than something trapped inside a container. Steps behind the current one collapse to a tick. Out of the box it renders four sample steps; connect your own array (Title per item) to Steps and it wins over the samples. Pairs with Form Fields, one fieldset per step.

label: Stripe
desc: Cloud functions and UI for Stripe payments and subscriptions — checkout, plan picker, and invoice handling. Configure by provisioning the backend function secrets STRIPE_API_KEY, STRIPE_CHECKOUT_SUCCESS_URL and STRIPE_CHECKOUT_CANCEL_URL — see the prefab README.

label: Supabase
desc: Supabase connector: pure-logic components for auth and data. Setup Client creates the client from your project URL + anon key (Noodl.Variables.supabase); Log In, Log Out, Sign Up, Send Magic Link, Send Password Reset, Resend Confirmation, Update/Fetch Current User Auth and Profile Data cover the auth flows, and an Example Request shows a from().select() query. No UI — wire the Do/Success/Failure signals into your own pages. Originally by @gmaison and @RicoTrevisan.

label: Tab Bar
desc: A tab bar component, useful for creating tab navigation.

label: Table
desc: A table built from data: columns are derived from your rows (or declared with a Headers array), each cell picks its own String/Number/Boolean/Date/Image renderer from the value's type, headers sort and cells can be made editable. Out of the box it renders five sample rows from a Static Data node; connect your own array to the Items input and it wins over the samples.

label: Tags
desc: A wrapping row of tag pills, optionally removable and clickable, with colours generated from each tag's own text so the same label is always the same colour. Out of the box it renders six sample tags from a Static Data node; connect your own array of { Label } to the Items input and it wins over the samples.

label: Time Picker
desc: A time picker input for selecting hours and minutes.

label: Toast
desc: Contains Toast messages for success, warnings, errors, and neutral.

label: Toggle Switch
desc: A toggle switch UI component.

label: TOTP
desc: Cloud functions for auth with timebased one time passwords like Google Auth.

label: User Menu
desc: The avatar button that lives in the top-right of an app: a person's picture (or their initials when there is no picture), their name and email, and a dropdown holding account items and a Sign Out. Click it to open, click anywhere else to close. Out of the box it renders a sample person and four sample items from Static Data nodes; connect Name/Email/Avatar and an Items array and they win over the samples. Publishes Item Clicked with Clicked Label and Clicked Item Id, and a Sign Out signal to wire at the Log Out node beside Auth Pages.

label: Xano
desc: Connects to Xano and handles queries, users and authTokens. Built by @gmaison.
